channel.title: Meeting Notes Updates
channel.description: Signed application updates for Meeting Notes.

item.description:
## Meeting Notes 1.3.2
- **Send to ChatGPT works again with the updated ChatGPT app.** The new ChatGPT desktop app moved its bundled Codex tool, so Meeting Notes reported that Codex was not installed. It now finds the tool wherever the app ships it. - Summaries use the same lookup, so they also work on Macs without a separately installed Codex CLI. - Recording can now exclude specific apps from system audio. - Recordings pause after a long stretch of silence. - Syncing can no longer hang forever on a stuck rsync or SSH connection. - Meeting content is kept out of diagnostic logs. - Updated Sparkle to 2.10.0 and FluidAudio to 0.15.7.
